name: @voko/lite
description: Cross-platform local Agent IM runtime for secure Agent-to-Agent communication and collaboration via MCP, CLI, HTTP, and Web UI.
author: Hong Kong Leung Pin Ho On Technology Limited

scripts.package:build: npm run build:ts && npm run package:verify-schema
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:ts && npm run test:unit:build
scripts.test:component: npm run build:ts && npm run test:component:build
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:ts && npm run test:coverage:build
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run build:ts && npm run i18n:check && npm run test:coverage:build && node scripts/check-core-coverage.js
scripts.test:real:smoke: npm run build:ts && node scripts/real-test.js smoke
scripts.test:real:recovery: npm run build:ts && node scripts/real-test.js recovery
scripts.test:real:providers: npm run build:ts && node scripts/real-test.js providers
scripts.test:real:stability: npm run build:ts && node scripts/real-test.js stability
scripts.test:real:all: npm run build:ts && node scripts/real-test.js all
scripts.test:targeted: npm run build:ts && node scripts/run-targeted-tests.js && node test/group-mcp-tools.test.js
scripts.test:channels: npm run build:ts && node --test test/lite-channel-registry.test.js test/lite-mcp-contract.test.js test/lite-owner-intervention-context.test.js test/lite-owner-intervention-reliability.test.js test/owner-intervention-group-resume.test.js
scripts.test:agent-files: npm run build:ts && node --test test/lite-agent-files-contract.test.js test/agent-file-security.test.js
scripts.test:voko-email: npm run build:ts && node --test test/lite-voko-email.test.js test/lite-channel-registry.test.js test/owner-intervention-group-resume.test.js
scripts.test:wechat: npm run build:ts && node --test test/lite-wechat-handler.test.js test/lite-channel-registry.test.js test/owner-intervention-group-resume.test.js
scripts.test:messenger: npm run build:ts && node --test test/lite-messenger-type-safety.test.js test/lite-messenger-contract.test.js test/lite-reply-idempotency-e2e.test.js test/lite-owner-intervention-context.test.js test/owner-intervention-group-resume.test.js test/offline-sync.test.js && node test/group-message.test.js
scripts.test:payments: npm run build:ts && node --test test/mcp-payment-auth.test.js test/lite-core-services.test.js
scripts.test:registration: npm run build:ts && node --test test/agent-register-fields.test.js test/registration-orchestrator.test.js test/cli-register.test.js test/web-register.test.js test/lite-core-services.test.js
scripts.test:lite: npm run build:ts && npm run i18n:check && node test/smoke-all.js --require-running
scripts.github:preflight: node scripts/check-release-state.js push && npm run release:gate && npm run security:local && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:preflight: node scripts/check-release-state.js release && npm run release:gate && npm run security:local && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:verify: node scripts/check-release-state.js published && npm run verify:published-release
scripts.security:local: npm run security:gitleaks && npm run security:codeql
scripts.release:gate:code: npm run test:ci && npm run scan:package-secrets
